{{short description|French mathematician and librarian}}
[[File:Pierre de Carcavy LACMA AC1993.213.8.jpg|thumb|Engraving of Pierre de Carcavy's portrait, a Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Theodore Harris|300px]]
'''Pierre de Carcavi''' was born in about 1603, in [[Lyon, France]] and died in [[Paris]] in April 1684. He was a secretary of the [[Bibliothèque nationale de France|National Library of France]] under [[Louis XIV]]. Carcavi was a French [[mathematician]].<ref name=mt>{{MacTutor Biography|id= Carcavi}}</ref>

Carcavi is known for his correspondence with [[Pierre de Fermat]], [[Blaise Pascal]], [[Christiaan Huygens]], [[Galileo Galilei]], [[Marin Mersenne]], [[Evangelista Torricelli]] and [[René Descartes]].<ref name=mt/>
